title: Rapport Therapeutics Reports Q3 2026 Net Loss of $40.2 Million
summary: Rapport Therapeutics reported a Q3 2026 net loss of $40.2 million versus $26.9 million a year earlier and said it has cash runway through the end of 2029.
body_markdown:
The company ended the quarter with $395.0 million in cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments, excluding restricted cash, compared with $436.1 million as of June 30, 2026. In October 2026 it completed a public offering of common stock at $21.00 per share, an offering of 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2032 and a concurrent private placement, with aggregate net proceeds of approximately $410.7 million. It also sold approximately $10 million of stock under its at-the-market program in November 2026. Including those proceeds, Rapport estimated, on an unaudited basis, $815.4 million in cash and cash equivalents as of November 3, 2026.


## Why It Matters for RAPP


Rapport is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. On October 20, 2026, it reported that its Phase 2 trial of RAP-219 in adults with bipolar I disorder experiencing an acute manic episode met its primary endpoint, a 3.1-point placebo-adjusted improvement in Young Mania Rating Scale total score at Week 3. Chief executive Abraham N. Ceesay called the results "transformational for Rapport" and said the company is "well funded to deliver on the catalysts ahead."


The company said it plans to meet with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in the first quarter of 2027 to discuss the Phase 2 data and registrational trial design, and expects to start two Phase 3 trials in acute bipolar mania in the second half of 2027. It also expects initial data from an open-label long-term safety trial in FOS in the fourth quarter of 2026.
